article_salary_expenses.summary: Money at work has its own language, and most people learn it by accident. After reading this you can read a payslip, tell gross pay from net pay, compare two job offers properly, ask for a raise without guessing, and build a budget you can keep.
article_salary_expenses.title: How to Talk About Salary and Expenses

article_saying_hello.summary: A greeting is how a conversation starts. After reading this you can say hello to grown-ups and friends, say your own name, and start a small talk with anybody you meet.
article_saying_hello.title: Saying Hello and Introducing Yourself
